title: Dispatch Guidance: Pricing a Trade-In Tow Against the Delivery Run
content:
A **Trade-In Agreements** tow is priced according to how it was run against the delivery appointment of the purchase the trade is applied to, read from that appointment's status and completed date and from the trade's pickup date.

## Rule

| How the tow was run | Towing charge |
|---|---|
| The delivery was completed and the vehicle was towed on a different day from the delivery's completed date (the truck made a trip of its own) | The greater of the grade's towing fee and the per-mile tow rate for every mile of the round trip, twice the one-way tow distance, beyond the included tow miles |
| The delivery was completed and the vehicle was towed on the delivery's completed date (the tow rode with the delivery run) | The grade's towing fee alone |
| Every other case (the delivery not completed, or no delivery) | The grade's towing fee plus the per-mile tow rate for every mile of the one-way tow distance beyond the included tow miles |

No count of miles falls below none.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

Grade towing fee $149.00, included tow miles 25, per-mile tow rate $1.50.

| One-way distance | Pattern | Towing charge |
|---|---|---|
| 45 miles | Own trip, different day from the completed delivery | Round trip 90 less 25 is 65 miles at $1.50, $97.50; the greater of $149.00 and $97.50 is **$149.00** |
| 100 miles | Own trip, different day from the completed delivery | Round trip 200 less 25 is 175 miles at $1.50, $262.50; the greater is **$262.50** |
| 100 miles | Towed on the delivery's completed date | **$149.00** |
| 45 miles | Delivery not completed | $149.00 plus 20 miles at $1.50, which is **$179.00** |
